messages:
sarah: Drafting the internal release note and announce for 2026-03-25 window. Deploy bot scheduled 03:00 UTC. Need short copy, pin instructions, rollback bullets. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rn/PR-412

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy starting 2026-03-25 03:00:00 UTC to prod. Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Will post stage updates. :robot_face:

leo: Here's a concise RN draft for ops/customer-forwarding:

leo: ```
Release: 2026-03-25 - Serving runtime + model pin
What: kernel selection improvements; runtime pinned to v2026-03-18; model pinned gpt-rw-v2-2026-03
When: 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC (change window)
Impact: brief 1-2m tail-latency spike possible, no expected data loss. Canary rollout; auto-rollback on criteria below.
Action: engineers should verify per-route dashboards post-canary and ensure any custom pins are set.
Rollback: ops runbook steps below (redwood rollback ...).
```

maya: Please add exact auto-rollback triggers. Suggestion: 5xx > 1% sustained 5m OR p95 > +2000ms sustained 10m.

ethan: Agreed. I'll add the ops CLI snippets for pin/rollback/status.

ethan: ```
# pin model for prod
redwood model pin --env=prod --route=api.v1.chat --model=gpt-rw-v2-2026-03

# rollback example
redwood rollback --env=prod --route=api.v1.chat --to-version=2026-03-10

# deploy status
redwood deploy status --id=DEPLOY-20260325-01
```

ops-oncall: I'm oncall for the window. Handoff to eng-oncall at 02:30 UTC. I'll monitor PagerDuty and the deploy-bot thread. Ping here to escalate.

sarah: I'll incorporate the rollback criteria and ethan's CLI into the RN PR and add a short pinned announce for internal channel.

sarah: Internal announce (short):

sarah: "TODAY 03:00 UTC: deploying runtime & model pin to reduce inference regressions. Canary rollout 5%->25%->100%. Expect possible transient latency bump. Eng oncall: monitor listed routes. Ops: ready to rollback per runbook. RN: https://git.internal/redwood/rn/PR-412"

leo: LGTM. I'll post the internal announce ~20m before window and include the RN link. :thumbsup:

maya: SRE approves. Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/redwood/serving-routes?var-route=api.v1.chat

deploy-bot: Canary stage 1 complete: 5% -> progressing to 25% in 10m. Will update on 100% cutover.

sarah: Thanks. If no objections in 30m I'll merge the RN, publish pin instructions in the ops runbook, and add the checklist to the playbook.
